description: PRD-141 — Widget Vertical-Agnostic Refactor (Shopify PoC Hardening). Move Shopify-specific code out of orchestrator/api/widgets/chat.py and into orchestrator/integrations/shopify/. Make generic widget chat endpoint vertical-agnostic via per-workspace plugin dispatch (workspace.settings.vertical). Add page_context to regular SDK messages (currently only sent on proactive triggers). Preserve PRD-007 product-page opener + PRD-008-B cart-idle popup byte-for-byte using snapshot tests. Source PRD: docs/PRDS/141-WIDGET-VERTICAL-AGNOSTIC-REFACTOR.md. First Shopify PoC partner = INBUILD UK — they are the canary for every deploy. Touches THREE repos: automatos-ai (Python), automatos-widget-sdk (TypeScript), automatos-skills (skill markdown). Most stories are automatos-ai; US-013/014/015 are SDK; US-016/017 are skills.

userStories.title: Add Alembic migration backfilling workspace.settings.vertical for Shopify workspaces (Phase 1)
userStories.description: As an operator, I need every existing Shopify workspace to have settings.vertical = 'shopify' set before chat.py is rewired to dispatch by vertical, so existing INBUILD traffic continues to route to the Shopify plugin.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/alembic/versions/<timestamp>_backfill_workspace_vertical.py
Upgrade: UPDATE workspaces SET settings = jsonb_set(settings, '{vertical}', '"shopify"', true) WHERE settings ? 'shopify_domain' AND NOT settings ? 'vertical'
Downgrade: UPDATE workspaces SET settings = settings - 'vertical' WHERE settings ? 'shopify_domain' AND settings->>'vertical' = 'shopify' — only removes vertical from workspaces we set it on
Migration is idempotent — running twice doesn't change rowcount on second run
Migration is reviewed by the migration-reviewer agent (no locking risk, no NOT NULL on big table — this is a JSONB update on a small table)
Log/comment in the migration: 'PRD-141 Phase 1 — backfill workspace.settings.vertical for all existing Shopify workspaces. Verify count matches expected Shopify workspace count after upgrade.'
Migration applied successfully on staging; rowcount logged
userStories.notes: DO NOT default vertical='shopify' for all workspaces — only those with shopify_domain set. Workspaces without a vertical setting will default to 'generic' at dispatch time. Migration order: this story must land in the SAME PR as US-010 (the rewire) — otherwise there's a window where dispatch returns 'generic' for INBUILD and breaks proactive.

userStories.title: Canary deploy Phase 1 on INBUILD workspace and verify 24h soak (Phase 1 release gate)
